units.source: Voice Changer Online — Free Voice Effects in Your Browser
Change pitch, shape radio or deep-voice effects, preview echo, and export processed audio locally. Free, private, and no upload.
Give a short audio clip a lower, higher, radio, bright, or echo effect. Preview the result, adjust it, and export a WAV file on your device.
Try a voice recording and compare the original with the radio or lower-pitch preset. Pitch changes also change playback speed; this is not voice cloning or studio-grade pitch correction.
Your browser decodes the selected audio, applies Web Audio filters, gain, pitch-rate and optional echo locally, then renders a WAV file for download. No audio is sent to a server.

This lightweight tool is designed for short clips, not full-length songs. Pitch is changed by adjusting playback rate, so the clip duration and voice tone change together. Effects cannot create a natural new identity, separate voices, or guarantee the same result on every browser.
Use a format your browser can decode. Maximum 25 MB and 30 seconds.

Does pitch shift keep the original duration?
No. This lightweight pitch control changes playback rate, so a lower pitch plays slower and a higher pitch plays faster.
Can it clone a voice or separate vocals?
No. It applies simple audio effects. It does not clone a person, isolate vocals, or turn a voice into another real person.
The tool renders a standard uncompressed WAV file in your browser. The input may be any audio format that your browser can decode.

Shikaku Puzzle Online — Free Daily Rectangle Game
Play Shikaku online for free. Divide each grid into rectangles that match the numbered areas. Get a daily puzzle, hints and a fresh board; your game stays on this device.
Draw rectangles so every number is the area of exactly one region. Cover every square once, with no overlaps.
Free to play. Your puzzle and progress stay in this browser.
A clue marked 6 belongs inside one rectangle that covers exactly six squares.
Choose a start square, then choose an end square to draw a rectangle. You can also drag across the grid. Every rectangle must contain one clue whose number matches its area.
Puzzles are made in your browser. A larger grid can take a moment on a slower device. No account or file upload is needed.
Free · no account · saved on this device
Choose a grid size and start.
Click two opposite corners or drag to draw a rectangle. Keyboard: Tab to a square, then Enter to select it.
That rectangle does not match a clue or overlaps another one.
Solved! Every square is covered correctly.
Check the rectangle areas and clues.
Hint: a correct rectangle is outlined.
Solution shown. Start a new puzzle to play again.
Shikaku is a number puzzle. Draw rectangles around the clues. Each rectangle has the area shown by its clue, and all grid squares must be used once.
Can a rectangle contain two numbers?
No. Each rectangle must contain exactly one number clue.
This game only accepts generated boards with one verified solution.
Does my progress leave this device?
No. Progress is stored only in this browser unless you clear its site data.
Free DXF Viewer — View Layers, Measure and Export SVG
Open ASCII DXF drawings locally. View supported 2D lines, circles, arcs and polylines, toggle layers, measure distances and export the supported geometry as SVG or PNG.
Open an ASCII DXF drawing on this device. Pan and zoom, show or hide layers, measure a distance, and export the geometry this viewer supports. The original file is not uploaded.

The file is read in this browser and is not uploaded. Only basic 2D lines, circles, arcs and straight-segment polylines are drawn; unsupported entities are listed and excluded from measurements and export.
A line from (0, 0) to (10, 0) measures 10 drawing units. The viewer reads the DXF unit code when present; when it is absent, measurements are labelled as drawing units.
A local worker parses ASCII DXF. No scripts, external references, images, fonts or network resources in the file are executed or fetched. This viewer does not open DWG or binary DXF.

Supported preview and export: LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, and straight LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE in the XY plane. Bulged curves, text, blocks, dimensions, splines, 3D entities and other types are listed as unsupported and are not included in measurements or exports. Maximum file size: 10 MB; maximum group records: 200,000.
No. This tool opens ASCII DXF only. It does not decode DWG or binary DXF.
The viewer draws only the entity types listed in its supported-content section. Other entities are reported by type and count; they are not silently approximated.
